scripts.typecheck: bun --bun run tsrs --project tsconfig.quickjs.json && bun --bun run tsrs --project packages/composer/tsconfig.json
scripts.test:rust: cargo test --workspace && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings && cargo doc --workspace --no-deps

scripts.check: cargo fmt --check && bun run typecheck && bun run test:rust && bun run test:ts
